nodes.label: Internal working quote (rev 2)
nodes.rationale: ~32 hrs done + ~57 left ~= ~90 hrs at AUD $22/hr ~= $2,000 labour + ~$75 infra. The three timeline risks (Akamai, image hosting, product discovery) are done and proven in a live Shopify import; what remains is catalogue-scale build and QA. Lists 16 risks/assumptions.

nodes.label: ScraperAPI unblocker
nodes.rationale: Tested end to end: clean pages, real product data, 1 credit per request. One full crawl ~= 1,542 credits; project with dev re-runs ~6-10k, run on one month of the Hobby plan (USD $49 / 100k credits), cancelled on delivery. Removes Akamai as a project risk.

nodes.label: Oakley size-variant explosion
nodes.rationale: Parser handles eyewear (one-size) today. ~580 products (apparel 310, footwear 35, goggles) need the size axis parsed from the PDP and exploded colour x size; ~8-10 hrs.

nodes.label: Oakley colourway grouping decision
nodes.rationale: Oakley lists each colour of a model as its own product page. Default = mirror the source (one Shopify product per colourway). Grouping into one product with a Colour option adds ~4-10 hrs on Oakley; needs a client decision.

nodes.label: Crispi AU = 13 products scope
nodes.rationale: The brief's 'Cirspi / cirspiaustralia.com.au' does not resolve; the live site is crispiaustralia.com.au. 13 products is the entire AU catalogue (verified via store API + category counts). Crispi globally makes 40+ models on crispi.com, a different site and re-scope. Confirm with the client.
